item.title: Uitsmijter 0.11.0: Login Without a Keyboard, Providers Without a Script
item.description:
Uitsmijter 0.11.0: Login Without a Keyboard, Providers Without a Script  

Uitsmijter 0.11.0 is a wide release. It opens the door to a whole new class of clients — smart TVs, CLIs, and IoT devices that can’t reasonably show a login form — and at the same time it makes connecting Uitsmijter to your own user store dramatically simpler. Underneath, several endpoints were brought back in line with the OAuth and OIDC specifications, which quietly improves interoperability with off-the-shelf clients.

item.title: Signing in without a keyboard — the Device Authorization Grant
item.description:
We have all been there: a fresh smart TV, a shiny streaming box, and a login screen that wants an email address and a password — one painful letter at a time, hunting across an on-screen keyboard with a remote control. It is slow, it is error-prone, and typing a real password that way feels wrong the moment you start.

The web already solved this problem, and with Uitsmijter 0.11 the solution comes to your own SSO: the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628), often just called the device flow.
